text: Journalism is a social science discipline that focuses on the study of news phenomena, news activities, and news dissemination laws. It combines theoretical depth with practical operability. It covers the entire process of information collection, processing, and dissemination, and explores the functions, roles, and impacts of news media in society. The aim is to cultivate professional talents with news sensitivity, solid skills in reporting, editing, and commentary, as well as a thorough understanding of dissemination laws, to meet the demands of the media industry and society for high-quality information disseminators.
